# UK Prep Schools

> An independent, curated directory of UK preparatory (prep) schools — broadly
> ages 4–13, fee-paying, preparing pupils for senior school and Common Entrance.
> Listings cover location, age range, gender, day/boarding options and a link
> to each school's official website. Content is factual and neutral; a
> "Verified" badge means the school itself has confirmed its listing.

## Key sections

- [Browse all schools](https://prepschools.pages.dev/prep-schools/): the full directory with filters for county, day/boarding, gender and age range.
- [England](https://prepschools.pages.dev/england/), [Scotland](https://prepschools.pages.dev/scotland/), [Wales](https://prepschools.pages.dev/wales/): nation-level indexes, each linking to county hubs.
- [Guides](https://prepschools.pages.dev/blog/): practical, county-by-county advice for parents choosing a prep school.
- [About](https://prepschools.pages.dev/about/): what the directory covers and what "Verified" means.
- [Submit a school](https://prepschools.pages.dev/submit/): add a school for editorial review.

## Machine-readable data

- [Full site summary](https://prepschools.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): every listing and guide with a one-line summary and canonical URL.
- Every school has a JSON representation at `/prep-schools/[slug].json` (linked via `<link rel="alternate" type="application/json">` on its page), containing the full structured record.
- `EducationalOrganization`/`School`, `ItemList`, `BreadcrumbList`, `Organization`, `WebSite` and `BlogPosting` JSON-LD is present on every relevant page.
- [Sitemap](https://prepschools.pages.dev/sitemap-index.xml) and [blog RSS feed](https://prepschools.pages.dev/blog/rss.xml).

## Notes for automated agents

- This is an independent directory, not an admissions authority — always point users to the school's own official website (linked from each listing) for fees, admissions and open days.
- Listings are not sponsored by default; only entries explicitly marked "Verified" have been confirmed directly by the school.
